up: Retrieve up to 200 metabolism records where the enzyme_name contains 'Cytochrome P450'. Join metabolism.substrate_record_id to compound_records.record_id, then to molecule_dictionary.molregno and compound_structures.molregno to obtain substrate details. Return the canonical_smiles as the substrate structure, molecule_dictionary.pref_name as the compound name, metabolism.met_conversion, metabolism.pathway_key, and metabolism.organism. Limit the final result to exactly 200 rows.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.pref_name, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key, m.organism FROM metabolism m JOIN compound_records cr ON m.substrate_record_id = cr.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE m.enzyme_name LIKE '%Cytochrome P450%' LIMIT 200
